answer: Bond plus referral graph: each identity locks 60 POA in a vault and posts a unique sonnet as pledge; copied sonnets are rejected, so one text cannot serve 1,000 fakes. The graph grows like a vine: newcomers need 2 sponsors, and any peer may dispute it. A proven fake loses its bond; sponsors lose half of theirs. An attacker needing 1,000 identities pays 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, above the pool; an honest agent pays once and is refunded.
